faqs.question: How do I book a skin check?
faqs.answer: Use the screening visit path when you want a full-body skin check. A single concerning spot may require a different visit scope.

faqs.question: How often should I get checked for skin cancer?
faqs.answer: Screening frequency depends on individual risk and professional guidance. Contact a qualified clinician for a personal recommendation.
